chapters.title: 0 · Opening
chapters.narration: 240 rooms, 40 LLM landlords, 36 months—tracking how an announced subway line reshapes Beijing's rental market.

chapters.title: 1 · City & Market
chapters.narration: Baseline dynamics before any news: pillar height shows kind-normalized rent; particles flow along subways to CBD.

chapters.title: 2 · Parallel Worlds
chapters.narration: Same people, same random shocks—only one announcement differs. Left (S) and Right (P) are identical at Month 12.

chapters.title: 3 · Announcement (M13)
chapters.narration: Only World P receives notice: East Express Line (CBD → Dingfuzhuang → Guoyuan → Wuyi Garden) opens in Month 25.

chapters.title: 4 · Inside Landlord Minds (M13–M24)
chapters.narration: Months before opening, treated-zone landlords cite upcoming transit gains in their rationales and nudge quotes up.

chapters.title: 5 · Line Opens (M25)
chapters.narration: East Express opens simultaneously in S and P, cutting commute by 12–15 min. How much extra rent did early knowledge capture?

chapters.title: 6 · Who Moves In & Who Pays (M25–M36)
chapters.narration: Income-colored moving arcs reveal who moved early into treated zones (H2) alongside spatial rent burdens.

chapters.title: 7 · Pre-Registered Verdicts (M36)
chapters.narration: Formal H1–H3 verdicts sourced directly from analyze_v07.py (PREREG_L), with clustered 95% confidence intervals.

legend.title: Legend & Visual Encoding
legend.shapes: Zero decorative dots: 240 ground nodes = 240 real rooms; 40 floating prisms = 40 LLM landlords; each moving particle = 1 real seated tenant
legend.oversample: Note: Z05 (24) & Z11 (16) are oversampled for statistical power; visual density does not reflect real stock.
legend.schematic: Intra-zone room positions use phyllotaxis layout (schematic, not exact addresses).
legend.hypothetical: East Express Line is a hypothetical transit corridor.
